visual_review.method: Inspected native front and rear demo frames at 0, 10, 20, 26, 30, 32, 42, 53, 64, 70, 75.5 and 85.5 seconds; overhead sequence and all three final judging views. Dream front frames at 0, 18, 36, 54, 72 and 90 seconds. Independently replayed every measured step.
visual_review.demo: Starts with the loose overhand. One hand raises an arch while the other feeds the red end through it. The cord briefly hangs on an open finger; an ordinary regrasp and closing that empty finger free it. Both tips are then grasped, spread, laid on the tabletop and released. Final native score 1.0: zero crossings, intact cord and 6.2 seconds released. Front/rear views complement each other to show both ends of the final one-metre cord.
visual_review.dream: Uses all 1800 actions but leaves the initial knot intact; score 0.0.
visual_review.limitations: Coarse capsule chain with approximate bending, torsion and compression. Native contacts permit transient capsule overlap; the largest measured overlap occurs after the end is unthreaded. No sampled centreline intersection was detected, which is not a continuous collision guarantee. No ideal attachments, teleporting or scripted untying forces. Static topology is supplementary to visible released straightness.

contact_diagnostic.scope: Every 20 Hz native recorded centreline. Finite capsule compression may occur. This is not a continuous collision certificate.
